Internal note — looping in Sean for finance/discount governance. Quick internal stance from RevOps/Sales:
- Discount: We can approve up to 20% discount programmatically for deals >= $200k ARR equivalent (6-month commit pro-rated). Anything above 20% requires Sales Director sign-off and an escalation to Pricing Committee.
- Engineering credit: $20k can be approved as an onboarding/POC credit if the committed ARR meets the $240k target; must be recorded as a one-time implementation credit on the invoice, not as recurring.
- Commit sizing: Recommend we present two options to Acme:
  A) Baseline: 6-month commit, $240k — 20% discount + $20k credit (internal approval: Rishi + RevOps).
  B) Stretch: 12-month commit, $480k — 25% discount + $35k credit (requires Director approval and Legal sign-off for revised SLA).
